shots.prompt: A narrow fog-choked Whitechapel street at night, wet cobblestones reflecting amber gaslight, soot-stained brick warehouses on both sides, a single cast-iron gas lamp flickering amber, thick fog drifting in layers across the frame, no people visible yet, eerie empty street vanishing into fog, camera slowly pushes forward at eye level with slight handheld drift, gaslight glow breathing gently.

High wide establishing shot over the East End rooftops at night, forest of brick chimneys, thick fog sea below, distant gas lamps like amber sparks, camera slowly tilts down over the smoking rooftops, no people, vast Victorian slum skyline, cold moonlight with warm lamp accents.

A hunched elderly constable in a dark blue Victorian police greatcoat and round helmet carries a lantern down a narrow night street, amber lantern light swinging across wet brick walls, camera tracks slowly from behind at his shoulder level, fog, cautious footsteps, the lantern is the only light source, grim mood.

Point of view shot from the constable: his amber lantern light falls upon a folded woollen shawl lying on dark wet cobblestones beside a brick wall, a worn shoe tip barely visible at the frame edge, he stops abruptly, lantern held still in the air, horror in stillness, no face, no wound, no body details, slow push toward the shawl.

High-angle overhead shot of a crowded Victorian courtyard back yard at dawn, grey-blue morning light, a crowd of working-class Londoners in shawls and flat caps pressing toward the centre, subtle slow motion, wet mud, brick walls, laundry lines, no faces visible clearly, documentary realism, camera slowly descends.

A slim detective superintendent in a long dark grey frock coat and top hat steps out of a doorway and takes off his hat, thin weary face, he scans the crowd, camera slowly lowers from his eye level to chest level, cold morning light, cobblestones, crowd in soft bokeh behind him, restrained tension.

Interior of an 1880s newspaper printing works, huge iron rotary press with rollers turning, sheets of newsprint flying out, steam and dust in gaslight, rhythmic machine motion, camera medium shot slightly low angle, warm industrial amber light, no readable text on the papers.

Overhead close-up of a desk: a pale man's hand with stiff white cuffs dips a steel nib pen into an inkwell of red ink, the pen moves across cream paper leaving a wet red trail, candlelight, dark wooden desk, rich paper texture, no readable words, camera slow push in, ominous calm.

Macro shot of cream paper under candlelight: a wet red ink trail is still absorbing into the fibrous paper, ink edges bleeding softly, a blotting pause, dark background, shallow focus on the paper texture, no letters, no words, slow rack focus, atmosphere of dread.

A ragged twelve-year-old newsboy in a torn flat cap and oversized coat waves a folded newspaper on a crowded Victorian street, shouting, people in shawls turning their heads, fog, gaslight, handheld documentary feel, no readable headlines, urgent energy.

Night exterior of a small shop front in Berner Street, a lonely horse at a hitching rail rears slightly, ears forward, breath steaming, pale moonlight with amber gaslight spill, fog, cobblestones, empty street, camera slow lateral dolly, stillness before alarm.

A policeman's lantern light sweeps across the mouth of an alley and falls on a shawl lying on the ground beside a dark wall, his boots stop at the light's edge, silhouette only, fog, cobblestones, no face, no body, no wound, camera slow push toward the shawl, dread.

A Victorian police constable with a lantern walks through a dim square under stone arches, his light sweeps gradually across the wet ground, fog and moonlight, long shadows, camera medium wide rear three-quarter shot, slow dolly, ominous calm.

A detective superintendent in a dark frock coat studies a map spread over a wooden table in a dim police office at night, his finger moves between two marked points, gas lamp above, deep shadows on his exhausted face, camera slow push in over his shoulder, no readable map text.

Close-up of a brick wall at night in a street doorway: chalk marks smudged on brick, the light of a police lantern trembling across the surface, a hand in a white glove enters holding a wet rag, tension, soot-stained bricks, no readable letters, slow zoom.

Macro shot of a gloved hand wiping a wet rag across a brick wall, chalk marks dissolving into smears, the light of a police lantern crosses the wall, heavy breathing implied by hand motion, dark cloth sleeve with gold braid cuff, no readable lettering, camera slow push.

Night exterior of a two-storey Victorian lodging house facade in a narrow court, one upstairs window glows with flickering firelight, other windows dark, gas lamp at the corner, fog, cobblestones, camera slow push toward the glowing window, dread.

Shot from behind a young tenant assistant in a checked apron and rumpled shirt as he leans toward a window, his fingers hook the curtain edge and pull it a fraction, he suddenly recoils and staggers back, firelight flickers on his silhouette, we never see inside the window, camera slow lateral dolly.

A police detective in a dark coat closes a leather-bound case file on a desk in a candlelit records room, shelves of files receding into shadows, his hand rests on the closed cover, candle flame trembles, camera slow rack focus from hand to his tired eyes, no readable text.

Two silhouette portraits on a dark wall are lit one by one by a moving candle flame: first a tall thin man with a large beard, then a bespectacled man in a top hat, each face is half-hidden in shadow, the candle passes and each portrait sinks back into darkness, no names, no text, camera slow dolly.

Two more silhouette portraits on a dark wall lit by a passing candle: a doctor holding a medical bag, then a painter with a beret, followed by an empty ornate frame, each lit briefly then fading to darkness, dust in the light beam, dread and ambiguity, no text.

Extreme close-up: a magnifying glass over a woollen shawl fibre on a dark table, candlelight, then a stylized outline of a DNA double helix glows faintly in the background, blending documentary evidence with abstract science, camera slow push through the lens, no text.

A thick case file opens on a desk, paper pages flutter as if by a draft, a hand holds the pages still, candlelight, shelves of dusty archives behind, dust motes in the light, freeze as the hand stops, no readable text, camera slow push.

The same Whitechapel street from the opening but in the present: fog has cleared, the gas lamp is now a modern streetlight, blurred pedestrians walk past quickly in long exposures, brick walls remain but cleaner, warm morning light over the same cobblestones, camera slow dolly, nostalgic documentary look, no faces in focus.

Same street, one blurred pedestrian silhouette stops in the middle of the frame, turns his head toward the camera and freezes, the street around him continues in motion blur, shallow depth of field on the empty foreground, eerie and quiet, camera slow push toward the silhouette.

The foggy Whitechapel street at night seen once more from the opening angle, thick fog drifting, one distant gas lamp catches a slow pass of rain, empty cobblestones glistening, camera holds still for a long beat as the fog closes in, silent, unresolved, no people.
